preconditions.description: The length of the string must be between 1 and 200000.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == L and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string must have a length equal to L and consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the length of the longest string that appears at least twice.
The length of the longest repeated string must be non-negative.
